<!-- Exit Intent -->
<script>
    let AB_BUCKET = "control";
    let weightageOfVariant = 0;
    let popupShown = false;
    let highIntentClickCount = 0; // Counter for high intent clicks
    const highIntentThreshold = 1; // Number of clicks to mark a user as high intent
    const highIntentCookieName = "highIntentUser";
  
  
  
    function getDeviceType() {
      var e = navigator.userAgent;
      return /mobile/i.test(e)
        ? "Mobile"
        : /iPad|Android|Touch/i.test(e)
          ? "Tablet"
          : "Desktop";
    }
  
    function mobileDevice() {
      return getDeviceType() === "Mobile";
    }
  
    function desktopDevice() {
      return getDeviceType() == "Desktop";
    }
  
    function splitTraffic() {
      let isVarient = false;
      try {
        uuid = getCookie("unique_visitor_id6") || "";
        const trimmedUuid = uuid.slice(0, 50);
        const lastTwoDigits = parseInt(trimmedUuid.slice(-2)); // Defaults to base 10
        isVarient = lastTwoDigits >= weightageOfVariant;
  
        // if(location.host.includes("learn") && !desktopDevice()){
        //   isVarient = lastTwoDigits >= 30;
        // }
  
        if (window.clarity) {
          window.clarity(
            "set",
            "intent-variant",
            isVarient ? "variant" : "control"
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(error);
      }
      return isVarient;
    }
  
      
  
  function trackHighIntentClicks() {
    const setCookie = (name, value, hours) => {
      const date = new Date();
      date.setTime(date.getTime() + hours * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      var expires = "expires=" + date.toUTCString();
          
      var domainParts = document.location.hostname.split('.');
      var baseDomain = domainParts.slice(-2).join('.')
      var domain = "domain=." + baseDomain;
      var sameSite = "SameSite=None; Secure";
  
      document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) + ";" + expires + ";" + domain + ";path=/;" + sameSite;
    }
  
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      // Check if the clicked element is a link, button, or interactive element
      const linkTarget = e.target.closest("a");
      const buttonTarget = e.target.closest("button");
      const inputTarget = e.target.closest("input[type='button'], input[type='submit']");
      const dropdownTarget = e.target.closest(".p_switch_up_btn, .p_switch_up_cntnt");
      const interactiveTarget = e.target.closest("[data-click-id], [data-cta-id] [onclick], [role='button']");
      
      // Track clicks on any interactive element
      if (linkTarget || buttonTarget || inputTarget || dropdownTarget || interactiveTarget) {
        // Increment the high intent click counter for any interactive element click
        highIntentClickCount++;
  
        if (highIntentClickCount >= highIntentThreshold) {
          console.log("High intent user detected. Suppressing popup.");
          // Set a cookie to suppress the popup for high intent users
          setCookie(highIntentCookieName, "true", 6); // Suppress popup for 6 hours
        }
      }
    });
  }
  
  
    function hideCurrentModalOnBlogPage() {
      const pathname = window.location.pathname;
  
      if (pathname.includes("/blogs/")) {
        const modalElements = document.querySelectorAll(".fs_modal-2_component");
        modalElements.forEach((element) => {
          element.style.display = "none";
        });
      }
    }
  
    function initExitIntentPopup(eagerLoadImage, options = {}) {
      const COOKIE_NAME = "exitIntentPopupShown";
  
      // Configurable parameters with default values
      const {
        downScrollThreshold = 50, // Minimum scroll down percentage to start tracking upward scroll
        upScrollThreshold = 5, // Minimum upward scroll percentage to trigger popup after scrolling down
        upScrollSpeedThreshold = 1000 * 5, // pixel per seconds
        popupTimeoutHours = 6, // Timeout duration to prevent reappearing in hours
        initialScrollIgnore = 10, // Initial scroll percentage to ignore (avoids accidental triggers on load)
        bottomIgnoreThreshold = 5, // Bottom 5% of the page to ignore upward scrolls
        outsideViewportDelay = 500, // Minimum time outside viewport to trigger popup (in ms)
      } = options;
  
      let maxScrollPercent = 0; // Maximum scroll percentage reached by the user
      let popupInitialized = false;
      let exitPopup = null;
      let isTrackingUpScroll = false; // Flag to start tracking upward scroll only after downScrollThreshold is reached
      let lastUpScrollTimestamp = 0; // Timestamp of the last upward scroll detected
      let contextMenuOpen = false; // Flag to track if the context menu was opened
      let outsideViewportTimer; // Timer for tracking time outside viewport
      let lastScrollY = 0;
      let isFormInteracting = false; // Flag to track if user is interacting with form inputs
      let formInteractionTimeout; // Timer for form interaction cooldown
  
      // Utility to set a cookie with a specified expiry in hours
      const setCookie = (name, value, hours) => {
        const date = new Date();
        date.setTime(date.getTime() + hours * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        var expires = "expires=" + date.toUTCString();
  
        var domainParts = document.location.hostname.split(".");
        var baseDomain = domainParts.slice(-2).join(".");
        var domain = "domain=." + baseDomain;
        var sameSite = "SameSite=None; Secure";
  
        document.cookie =
          name +
          "=" +
          encodeURIComponent(value) +
          ";" +
          expires +
          ";" +
          domain +
          ";path=/;" +
          sameSite;
      };
  
      // Utility to get the value of a specific cookie by name
      const getCookie = (name) => {
        const cookies = document.cookie.split("; ");
        for (let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
          const cookie = cookies[i].split("=");
          if (cookie[0] === name) return cookie[1];
        }
        return null;
      };
  
      const closePopup = (overlay, trackClick = true) => {
        // Close popup
        overlay.style.display = "none";
  
        if (trackClick) {
          saveClickActivity(
            "exit_intent_close_button_clicked",
            new Date().getTime()
          );
        }
      };
  
      const createExitIntentPopup = () => {
        // Overlay
        const overlay = document.createElement("div");
        overlay.id = "exit-intent-overlay";
        overlay.style.position = "fixed";
        overlay.style.top = "0";
        overlay.style.left = "0";
        overlay.style.width = "100%";
        overlay.style.height = "100%";
        overlay.style.backgroundColor = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)";
        overlay.style.display = "flex";
        overlay.style.alignItems = "center";
        overlay.style.justifyContent = "center";
        overlay.style.zIndex = "9999";
  
        // Popup container
        const popup = document.createElement("div");
        popup.id = "exit-intent-popup";
        popup.style.position = "relative";
        // popup.style.backgroundColor = "white";
        popup.style.borderRadius = "8px";
        if (mobileDevice()) {
          popup.style.paddingTop = "30px";
          popup.style.paddingBottom = "30px";
          popup.style.maxWidth = "80%";
        } else {
          popup.style.maxWidth = "800px";
        }
        popup.style.maxHeight = "80%";
       // popup.style.boxShadow = "0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)";
        popup.style.textAlign = "center";
  
        // Image element
        const image = document.createElement("img");
        image.src = eagerLoadImage.src;
        image.alt = "IKIQ thumbnail";
        image.style.maxWidth = "100%";
        image.style.height = "auto";
        image.style.cursor = "pointer";
        image.style.borderRadius = "8px";
  
        // Image click event to redirect, close popup, and track activity
        image.onclick = () => {
          let targetUrl;
          if (window.blogExitIntentTargetUrl) {
            targetUrl = new URL(window.blogExitIntentTargetUrl, window.location.origin);
          } else if (webinarType === "SWITCH_UP") {
            targetUrl = new URL(
              "http://ik-organic-staging.local/ai-salary-analyzer"
            );
          } else {
            targetUrl = new URL("https://ikiq.interviewkickstart.com/resume-analysis");
          }
  
          const appendUTMParams = () => {
            let params = window.location.search;
            params = params.replaceAll("stayhere=1", "");
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(params);
  
            if ([...urlParams].length > 0) {
              urlParams.forEach((value, key) =>
                targetUrl.searchParams.append(key, value)
              );
            } else {
              const vLatestCookie = getCookie("v_latest");
              if (vLatestCookie) {
                try {
                  const utmParams = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(vLatestCookie));
                  utmParams["utm_source"] = utmParams["utm_source"] || "Organic";
                  Object.keys(utmParams).forEach((key) => {
                    if (utmParams[key]) {
                      const isNonLearnSite =
                        !window.location.host.includes("learn");
                      if (
                        isNonLearnSite &&
                        key === "utm_source" &&
                        (utmParams[key] === "Organic" || !utmParams[key])
                      ) {
                        targetUrl.searchParams.append(
                          "utm_source",
                          "exit_intent_organic"
                        );
                      } else {
                        targetUrl.searchParams.append(key, utmParams[key]);
                      }
                    }
                  });
                } catch (error) {
                  console.error("Failed to parse v_latest cookie:", error);
                }
              }
            }
          };
  
          appendUTMParams();
          window.open(targetUrl.toString(), "_blank");
  
          // Track image click activity
          saveClickActivity("exit_intent_image_clicked", new Date().getTime());
  
          closePopup(overlay, false);
        };
  
        popup.appendChild(image);
  
        // Close button
        const closeButton = document.createElement("span");
        closeButton.innerHTML = "×";
        closeButton.style.position = "absolute";
        closeButton.style.top = "0";
        closeButton.style.right = "14px";
        closeButton.style.cursor = "pointer";
        closeButton.style.fontSize = "32px";
        closeButton.style.color = "#555";
              
              // Nudge close button position on mobile
        if (mobileDevice()) {
          closeButton.style.top = "15px";
          closeButton.style.right = "5px";
        }
  
        // Close button click event to close popup and track activity
        closeButton.onclick = () => {
          closePopup(overlay);
        };
  
        popup.appendChild(closeButton);
  
        overlay.appendChild(popup);
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  
        // Close popup when clicking outside
        overlay.onclick = (event) => {
          if (event.target === overlay) {
            closePopup(overlay);
          }
        };
  
        return overlay;
      };
  
      const formClassList = [
        ".web_near_form",
        ".data_en_wb",
        ".elementor-popup-modal"
      ];
  
      // Check if any form element is visible on screen
      function isAnyFormVisible() {
        return formClassList.some(selector => {
          const element = document.querySelector(selector);
          if (!element) return false;
  
          const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
          return (
            rect.width > 0 &&
            rect.height > 0 &&
            rect.bottom > 0 &&
            rect.right > 0 &&
            rect.top < window.innerHeight &&
            rect.left < window.innerWidth &&
            window.getComputedStyle(element).visibility !== "hidden" &&
            window.getComputedStyle(element).display !== "none"
          );
        });
      }
  
      const shouldShowPopup = () => {
        let isFormOpened = false;
              let isVideoOpened = false;
              let isHighIntentUser = getCookie(highIntentCookieName) === "true";
  
              // Prevent showing popup while interacting with video
              if (isVideoInteracting) return false;
  
  
        try {
          isFormOpened = isAnyFormVisible();
          isVideoOpened =
            !!document.querySelector(".video_popup") &&
            document.querySelector(".video_popup").classList.contains("open");
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Failed to check if form or video is opened:", error);
        }
  
        //const isSwitchup = webinarType === "SWITCH_UP";
  
        const shouldShow =
          !getCookie(COOKIE_NAME) &&
          !popupShown &&
          !isFormOpened &&
          !isVideoOpened &&
          // !isSwitchup &&
          !isHighIntentUser;
        if (
          shouldShow &&
          window.location.pathname.includes("/blogs/") &&
          typeof blogPopupShown != undefined
        ) {
          return !blogPopupShown;
        }
        return shouldShow;
      };
      //codelogic
      const showPopup = () => {
        isQuotientPage = location.pathname.includes("result-ai-quotient-analyzer");
        const isSalaryAnalyzerPage = document.querySelector(".ai_salary_analyzer") !== null;
  
        // if (!isQuotientPage && !popupInitialized && shouldShowPopup()) {
        //   exitPopup = createExitIntentPopup();
        //   popupInitialized = true;
        // }
        if (!popupInitialized && shouldShowPopup()) {
          if (!isQuotientPage && !isSalaryAnalyzerPage) {
            // Create standard exit-intent popup
            exitPopup = createExitIntentPopup();
          }
          popupInitialized = true;
        }
  
  
        if (shouldShowPopup()) {
          if (isQuotientPage) {
            const wrapper = document.querySelector("#delayed-elementor-popup");
            const popup = document.querySelector(".data_en_wb");
            if (wrapper && popup) {
              wrapper.style.display = "block";
              popup.setAttribute("show_status", "true");
            }
          } else if (isSalaryAnalyzerPage) {
            const wrapper = document.querySelector("#delayed-elementor-popup");
            const popup = document.querySelector(".ai_salary_analyzer");
            if (wrapper && popup) {
              console.log("Wrapper", wrapper);
              wrapper.style.display = "block";
              popup.setAttribute("show_status", "true");
            }
          }
          else {
            exitPopup.style.display = "flex";
          }
  
          popupShown = true; // Mark the popup as shown in the current session
          setCookie(COOKIE_NAME, "true", popupTimeoutHours);
          saveClickActivity("exit_intent_popup_shown", new Date().getTime());
          hideCurrentModalOnBlogPage();
        }
      }
      // Detect scroll behavior to trigger popup on exit intent
      const detectExitIntentScroll = () => {
        const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
        const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
        const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
        const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
        const currentTimestamp = performance.now();
  
        // Calculate the current scroll percentage
        const currentScrollPercent =
          (scrollTop / (documentHeight - windowHeight)) * 100;
  
        // Ignore initial scrolls if they haven't reached the initialScrollIgnore threshold
        if (currentScrollPercent < initialScrollIgnore) {
          return;
        }
  
        // Track max scroll percentage and start tracking upward scroll after downScrollThreshold
        maxScrollPercent = Math.max(maxScrollPercent, currentScrollPercent);
        if (maxScrollPercent >= downScrollThreshold) {
          isTrackingUpScroll = true;
        }
  
        // Check for upward scroll only if downScrollThreshold was reached and not within the bottom ignore threshold
        if (
          isTrackingUpScroll &&
          currentScrollPercent <= maxScrollPercent - upScrollThreshold &&
          currentScrollPercent < 100 - bottomIgnoreThreshold
        ) {
          // Calculate the difference in scroll position and time
          const scrollDelta = lastScrollY - currentScrollY;
          const timeDelta = (currentTimestamp - lastUpScrollTimestamp) / 1000; // Convert to seconds
  
          // Avoid division by zero
          if (timeDelta > 0) {
            const scrollSpeed = scrollDelta / timeDelta; // pixels per second
  
            const rapidScrollThreshold = upScrollSpeedThreshold;
  
            if (scrollSpeed > rapidScrollThreshold) {
              showPopup();
            }
          }
  
          // Update the last scroll position and timestamp
          lastScrollY = currentScrollY;
          lastUpScrollTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
        }
      };
  
      const initializeScrollDetection = () => {
        window.addEventListener("scroll", detectExitIntentScroll);
      };
  
      // Mobile: Detect back button or history change attempt
      const detectBackButton = () => {
        window.addEventListener("popstate", () => {
          showPopup();
        });
  
        // Push a state to history to capture 'back' press
        window.history.pushState(null, "", window.location.href);
      };
  
      // Mobile & Desktop: Detect visibility change (tab or app going to background)
      const onVisibilityChange = () => {
        if (document.visibilityState === "hidden" && !isFormInteracting) {
          showPopup();
        }
      };
  
      // Mobile & Desktop: Detect blur event when focus leaves the browser window
      const onWindowBlur = () => {
        // Don't trigger if user is interacting with form inputs (autofill dropdown open)
        if (isFormInteracting) return;
        showPopup();
      };
  
      // Desktop: Detect mouseleave event to identify exit intent
      const onMouseLeave = (e) => {
        if (contextMenuOpen) return; // Ignore if context menu is open
        if (isFormInteracting) return; // Ignore if user is interacting with form inputs
  
        if (e.clientY <= 0 || e.relatedTarget === null) {
          // Set a timeout to show popup if user stays outside viewport for more than the specified delay
          outsideViewportTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            showPopup();
          }, outsideViewportDelay);
        }
      };
  
      // Cancel the popup if the user re-enters within 500ms
      const onMouseEnter = () => {
        clearTimeout(outsideViewportTimer); // Clear the timer if user returns within delay
      };
  
      // Track form input interactions to prevent exit intent during autofill
      const setupFormInteractionTracking = () => {
        const formInputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="text"], input[type="email"], input[type="tel"], input[type="number"], input[type="password"], textarea, select');
        
        formInputs.forEach(input => {
          // Skip if already attached to prevent duplicate listeners
          if (input._exitIntentTrackerAttached) return;
          
          // When user focuses on an input field
          input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
            isFormInteracting = true;
            clearTimeout(formInteractionTimeout);
            clearTimeout(outsideViewportTimer); // Cancel any pending exit intent popup
          });
          
          // When user clicks on an input field (before autofill dropdown opens)
          input.addEventListener('click', () => {
            isFormInteracting = true;
            clearTimeout(formInteractionTimeout);
            clearTimeout(outsideViewportTimer);
          });
          
          // When input value changes (autofill selection made)
          input.addEventListener('input', () => {
            isFormInteracting = true;
            clearTimeout(formInteractionTimeout);
            clearTimeout(outsideViewportTimer);
            // Reset after a short delay to allow autofill dropdown to close
            formInteractionTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
              isFormInteracting = false;
            }, 1000);
          });
          
          // When user blurs from input field (after autofill)
          input.addEventListener('blur', () => {
            // Keep the flag true briefly to catch any delayed autofill events
            formInteractionTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
              isFormInteracting = false;
            }, 800);
          });
          
          // When autofill happens (autocomplete event)
          input.addEventListener('autocomplete', () => {
            isFormInteracting = true;
            clearTimeout(formInteractionTimeout);
            clearTimeout(outsideViewportTimer);
            formInteractionTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
              isFormInteracting = false;
            }, 1000);
          });
          
          // Mark as attached to prevent duplicate listeners
          input._exitIntentTrackerAttached = true;
        });
      };
  
      // Track context menu open/close state
      window.addEventListener("contextmenu", () => {
        contextMenuOpen = true;
      });
  
      window.addEventListener("click", () => {
        contextMenuOpen = false;
      });
  
      // Add event listeners based on device type
      const initializeExitIntentDetection = () => {
        if (!mobileDevice()) {
          // Desktop-specific exit intent triggers
          document.addEventListener("mouseleave", onMouseLeave);
          document.addEventListener("mouseenter", onMouseEnter); // Track re-entering viewport
        } else {
          // Mobile-specific exit intent triggers
          detectBackButton();
          initializeScrollDetection(); // Only initialize scroll detection on mobile
        }
  
        // General triggers for both mobile and desktop
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibilityChange);
        window.addEventListener("blur", onWindowBlur);
        
        // Setup form interaction tracking to prevent exit intent during autofill
        setupFormInteractionTracking();
        
        // Watch for dynamically added form inputs
        const formObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
          setupFormInteractionTracking();
        });
        formObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      };
  
      // Run the initialization function when DOM is fully loaded
      document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        initializeExitIntentDetection
      );
    }
  
    function ignorePath() {
      const finalStepPages = [
        "signup-final-step",
        "signup-final-step-v6",
        "signup-final-step-switchup",
        "signup-final-step-switchup-v6",
        "ikiq-webinar-registration",
        "/webinar-registration",
        "/ai-quotient-analyzer",
        "/ai-salary-analyzer",
        "/ai-news-letter",
         "/courses/ai-for-marketing-professionals",
         "/courses/data-science-course",
					"/courses/ai-for-marketing",
      ];
  
      // Check if current URL matches any of the predefined final step pages
      const isFinalStepPage = finalStepPages.some((step) =>
        window.location.pathname.includes(step)
      );
  
      // Check for paths matching "/su/*"
      const isSuPage =
        window.location.pathname.startsWith("/su/") &&
        window.location.hostname === "interviewkickstart.com";
  
      return isFinalStepPage || isSuPage;
    }
  
    if (!ignorePath()) {
      const isVariant = splitTraffic();
      AB_BUCKET = isVariant ? "variant" : "control";
      if (isVariant) {
        const eagerLoadImage = new Image();
        let imageSrc;
        let targetUrl;
        const isLeadMagnetPage =
          window.location.pathname.includes("/blogs/") ||
          window.location.pathname.includes("/ai-for-all/");
  
        if (isLeadMagnetPage && window.currentLeadMagnet) {
          const leadMagnetKey = window.currentLeadMagnet;
  
          // Choose mobile or desktop image dynamically
          if (mobileDevice()) {
            imageSrc = window.exitIntentImagesMobile?.[leadMagnetKey] || "";
          } else {
            imageSrc = window.exitIntentImages?.[leadMagnetKey] || "";
          }
  
          // Link comes from leadMagnetUrls
          targetUrl = window.leadMagnetUrls?.[leadMagnetKey] || "#";
  
          // Pass along for popup click handler
          window.blogExitIntentTargetUrl = targetUrl;
        } else {
          console.log("eagerLoadImage", eagerLoadImage, webinarType)
          switch (true) {
            case mobileDevice() && webinarType === "SWITCH_UP":
              imageSrc = "http://ik-organic-staging.local/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/salary-mobile.webp";
              break;
  
            case mobileDevice():
              imageSrc = "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65b0a8bbe7894a07737a1710/6735d41ebced5e2946456b47_Mobile.webp";
              break;
  
            // Desktop Image
            case webinarType === "SWITCH_UP":
              imageSrc = "http://ik-organic-staging.local/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/salary-desktop.webp";
              break;
  
            default:
              imageSrc = "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65b0a8bbe7894a07737a1710/6736c3bbc05aac9dc828b94f_exit-intent-web.webp";
              break;
          }
        }
  
        eagerLoadImage.src = imageSrc;
  
        console.log("Current variant", "variant");
        initExitIntentPopup(eagerLoadImage, {
          downScrollThreshold: 1,
          upScrollThreshold: 20,
          upScrollSpeedThreshold: 1000 * 10,
          popupTimeoutHours: 3,
          checkInterval: 100,
          initialScrollIgnore: 15,
          bottomIgnoreThreshold: 5,
          outsideViewportDelay: 500, // Minimum time outside viewport to trigger popup (500ms)
        });
      } else {
        console.log("Current variant", "control");
      }
    }
      
  
  // --- Prevent exit intent popup when interacting with Vimeo player ---
          let isVideoInteracting = true; // Initially true as requested
  
          function setupVideoInteractionBlocker() {
              const videoSelectors = [
                  "#player",
                  ".vp-video-wrapper",
                  ".vp-telecine",
                  ".vp-video",
                  ".vp-content-area-background",
                  "iframe[src*='player.vimeo.com']"
              ];
  
              const attachListeners = (el) => {
                  if (!el._videoBlockerAttached) {
                      // Set to true when cursor enters video area
                      ["mouseenter", "mouseover", "focus", "click", "touchstart"].forEach((evt) => {
                          el.addEventListener(evt, () => {
                              isVideoInteracting = true;
                              clearTimeout(window._videoInteractTimeout);
                          });
                      });
                      
                      // Set to false when cursor leaves video area
                      ["mouseleave", "mouseout", "blur"].forEach((evt) => {
                          el.addEventListener(evt, () => {
                              clearTimeout(window._videoInteractTimeout);
                              window._videoInteractTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                  isVideoInteracting = false;
                              }, 100); // Small delay to prevent flickering
                          });
                      });
                      
                      el._videoBlockerAttached = true;
                  }
              };
  
              videoSelectors.forEach((selector) => {
                  document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(attachListeners);
              });
          }
  
          // Run when DOM and window load
          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", setupVideoInteractionBlocker);
          window.addEventListener("load", setupVideoInteractionBlocker);
  
          // Watch for dynamically loaded Vimeo iframe
          const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
              setupVideoInteractionBlocker();
          });
          observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  
          // --- Start high-intent tracking AFTER video blocker setup ---
          trackHighIntentClicks();

  </script>
